title: Agentic Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Agentic Developer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a full-time, remote Agentic Developer with 8+ years of experience in .NET, C#, Python, Node.js, or similar to join our client's Web / Foundations Team. In this role, you will contribute to the development and evolution of our client's core web platform, a mission-critical SaaS system that supports real-world customer workflows across healthcare, legal, education, and enterprise environments. You will play a key role in building and enhancing core product capabilities while ensuring reliability, scalability, and long-term maintainability.

In this context, agentic development refers to the structured use of AI

agents and LLM-powered workflows as part of the software development

lifecycle. This includes using agents to assist with design, implementation,

testing, debugging, and code quality while maintaining full ownership of

correctness and production readiness.

As a senior individual contributor, you will take ownership of systems end-to-end, influence architectural decisions, and help modernize the platform to meet growing business needs. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions, improve system performance, and elevate engineering standards. This is a high-impact position suited for engineers who think in systems, understand trade-offs, and can make sound technical decisions in a live, customer-facing environment.


Our U.S. client is a fast-growing, mission-driven language technology company developing the next generation of interpretation and multilingual communication platforms. title: Data Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Analyst em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About The Role


You'll join the Reporting & Analytics team at Pride Global — a high-impact, cross-functional group responsible for delivering data-driven insights across our global staffing operations.

This role sits at the center of how the business makes decisions. You’ll be responsible for building the reporting layer that powers executive dashboards, client presentations, and operational insights across the US, Canada, UK, and Brazil.

This is not just a dashboarding role. You’ll translate complex workforce, financial, and market data into clear, actionable narratives used by senior leadership and global business heads.

We need someone who can take ambiguous business questions, structure them into analytical problems, and deliver high-quality reporting solutions end-to-end — from data modeling to final presentation.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and develop Power BI dashboards used in executive-level reporting and client-facing presentations
  • Build self-service reporting solutions that allow business stakeholders to explore data independently
  • Create clean, intuitive, and visually effective dashboards optimized for both desktop and mobile consumption
  • Develop and manage Power BI datasets, workspaces, and deployment pipelines across Dev / UAT / Prod
  • Model data using star and snowflake schemas, applying best practices in DAX and Power Query (M)
  • Integrate and transform data from multiple sources — ATS, VMS/MSP platforms, SQL databases, Excel, SharePoint, and HR/ERP systems
  • Partner with business leaders to understand reporting needs and translate them into structured analytical outputs
  • Present insights and guide stakeholders through dashboards, explaining trends, limitations, and opportunities
  • Support recurring reporting cycles (weekly, monthly, quarterly) with accurate and timely delivery
  • Define and standardize key business metrics (headcount, spend, fill rates, aging, profitability, etc.)
  • Implement data quality checks, anomaly detection, and validation rules within reporting layers
  • Document data models, metric definitions, and reporting logic to ensure long-term scalability and governance


What We’re Looking For

Must have (3–5 years of experience):

  • Strong hands-on experience with Power BI (DAX, Power Query, data modeling, RLS)
  • Solid SQL skills (joins, aggregations, query optimization, working with relational databases)
  • Experience building reporting solutions for operational, workforce, or business performance data
  • Proven ability to design clean, executive-level dashboards with clear storytelling and minimal noise
  • Experience managing Power BI Service (workspaces, refresh schedules, access control, deployments)
  • Ability to translate business needs into analytical solutions and communicate insights effectively
  • Strong English communication skills (you’ll work with global stakeholders daily)


Nice to have:

  • Experience in staffing, workforce, or HR analytics
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, or similar cloud data platforms
  • Basic experience with Python or R for data preparation or automation
  • Exposure to data governance practices (metric standardization, data lineage, documentation)
  • Experience working in cross-functional environments (finance, operations, delivery teams)

title: English Teacher
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para English Teacher em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Professor de Espanhol
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de Espanhol em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as

title: Clinical Study Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Clinical Study Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Summary

The Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia’s headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote.


Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities

  • Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials.
  • Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required.
  • Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects.
  • Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines.
  • Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies.
  • Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation.
  • In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.g., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required.
  • Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials.
  • Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable.
  • Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively
  • Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions.
  • Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable.
  • Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product.
  • Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead.
  • Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans.
  • Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.e. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation.
  • Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report.
  • Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites.
  • Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required
  • Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct
  • Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated
  • Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives.
  • Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed.
  • Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets.


Education and Experience

  • Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management.
  • Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.g. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.).
  • Experience managing clinical project team personnel.
  • Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies.
  • Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations.
  • Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports.
  • Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process.
  • Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US.
  • Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members.
  • Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a ‘can-do’ attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines.


Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers.
  • Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate.
  • Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment.
  • Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment.
  • Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.).
  • .
  • Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers.
  • Must have the ability to accommodate international and domestic travel up to 30% at the request of the business.
  • Must be fluent in English

As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. description:

Brazil


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership;
  • Advanced English to be in contact with customer representative on a daily basis.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na squad de Busca, com foco em Busca Semântica, relevância e ranking. Essa posição tem papel estratégico na evolução da experiência de busca, atuando desde a definição de hipóteses até a implementação, experimentação e mensuração de impacto, com forte interface com Produto, Engenharia e Negócio.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e evoluir soluções de Busca Semântica utilizando Elasticsearch, indo além da busca lexical tradicional.
  • Atuar na definição e otimização de: Estrutura de índices e mappings Estratégias de ranking híbrido (lexical + semântico) Queries semânticas (ex: embeddings, similarity search, boosting contextual)
  • Trabalhar com vetorização de conteúdo (produtos, termos de busca, atributos) para melhoria de relevância.
  • Avaliar e evoluir métricas de qualidade de busca. Conduzir testes A/B e experimentos controlados para validar impacto das melhorias semânticas. Traduzir problemas de negócio e experiência do usuário em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados.
  • Atuar em parceria com Engenharia e Produto na definição do roadmap técnico de busca. Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente outros cientistas de dados do time, elevando o nível das discussões técnicas.


Requisitos necessários

  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins. Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados.
  • Experiência prática com Busca Semântica em Elasticsearch
  • Experiência com Information Retrieval (IR) e conceitos de relevância.
  • Conhecimento em NLP aplicado à busca (ex: embeddings, similaridade textual).
  • Experiência com modelos de ranking ou learning to rank.
  • Domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem.
  • Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto.
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume de dados. Noções de MLOps.
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.


Diferenciais

  • Vivência com BigQuery ou data lakes.
  • Experiência prévia em e-commerce, marketplace ou plataformas de discovery.
  • Experiência em observabilidade e monitoramento da qualidade da busca.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.


Perfil esperado

  • Forte mentalidade de produto e experiência do usuário.
  • Perfil analítico, curioso e orientado a impacto.
  • Autonomia para conduzir iniciativas complexas de ponta a ponta.
  • Capacidade de influenciar decisões técnicas e de produto com dados.
  • Boa colaboração em times multidisciplinares.

title: Data Annotator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Annotator em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who is Blueprint Technologies?

We are a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with a strong presence across the United States and an expanding footprint across Latin America (LATAM). Our teams are united by a shared passion for solving complex problems.


At Blueprint, we use technology as a bridge between strategy and execution. Our people bring diverse perspectives, deep expertise, and real-world experience across industries to help organizations grow, transform, and innovate.


About the Role

We are seeking detail-oriented Labelers / Annotators to evaluate responses generated by AI systems across multiple languages .


This role focuses on side-by-side (SBS) evaluation of outputs from different AI models across real-world scenarios. You will play a key role in improving how AI systems understand and communicate across languages and cultures.


This is not a translation role . It is an evaluation and analysis role requiring strong judgment and attention to detail.


Language Requirement

Fluency in English + at least one of the following languages:

  • Chinese (Simplified and/or Traditional)
  • Japanese
  • Korean
  • Italian
  • German
  • French


What You’ll Work On

You will evaluate AI responses across scenarios such as:

  • General-purpose Q&A
  • Web search results
  • File-based and image-based responses
  • Image and file generation tasks
  • Single-turn and multi-turn conversations


Responsibilities

  • Perform side-by-side (SBS) comparisons of AI-generated responses
  • Evaluate outputs based on:
  • Accuracy
  • Relevance
  • Clarity
  • Instruction-following
  • Identify nuances in tone, meaning, and cultural context across languages
  • Apply detailed, scenario-specific annotation guidelines

  • Mensageria: IBM MQ, Kafka ou RabbitMQ
  • Modelagem de dados: bases relacionais
  • DevOps: ferramentas e práticas de CI/CD, pipelines e containers


Conhecimentos Desejados (Diferenciais):

  • Arquitetura: CQRS, Event Sourcing
  • Acessibilidade (WCAG e boas práticas)
  • Fluxo de trabalho Git Flow e GitHub Actions
  • Busca e indexação: Apache Solr ou ElasticSearch
  • Experiência com microsserviços e escalabilidade


Soft Skills:

  • Comunicação clara

  • Colaboração
  • Adaptabilidade
  • Proatividade

title: Data Annotator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Annotator em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who is Blueprint Technologies?

We are a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with a strong presence across the United States and an expanding footprint across Latin America (LATAM). Our teams are united by a shared passion for solving complex problems.


At Blueprint, we use technology as a bridge between strategy and execution. Our people bring diverse perspectives, deep expertise, and real-world experience across industries to help organizations grow, transform, and innovate.


About the Role

We are seeking detail-oriented Labelers / Annotators to evaluate responses generated by AI systems across multiple languages .


This role focuses on side-by-side (SBS) evaluation of outputs from different AI models across real-world scenarios. You will play a key role in improving how AI systems understand and communicate across languages and cultures.


This is not a translation role . It is an evaluation and analysis role requiring strong judgment and attention to detail.


Language Requirement

Fluency in English + at least one of the following languages:

  • Chinese (Simplified and/or Traditional)
  • Japanese
  • Korean
  • Italian
  • German
  • French


What You’ll Work On

You will evaluate AI responses across scenarios such as:

  • General-purpose Q&A
  • Web search results
  • File-based and image-based responses
  • Image and file generation tasks
  • Single-turn and multi-turn conversations


Responsibilities

  • Perform side-by-side (SBS) comparisons of AI-generated responses
  • Evaluate outputs based on:
  • Accuracy
  • Relevance
  • Clarity
  • Instruction-following
  • Identify nuances in tone, meaning, and cultural context across languages
  • Apply detailed, scenario-specific annotation guidelines
  • Maintain consistency and high-quality evaluations


Required Qualifications

  • Professional fluency in English + at least one target language listed above
  • Prior experience with side-by-side (SBS) labeling or annotation
  • Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail
  • Ability to quickly understand and apply structured evaluation frameworks


Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in linguistics, translation, or localization
  • Experience in:
  • AI evaluation
  • Data annotation
  • Search relevance or content quality analysis


Compensation

We offer competitive compensation aligned with local markets and experience.

Estimated hourly range: R$75 – R$85 BRL

Estimated monthly equivalent (full-time): R$12,000 – R$13,600 BRL

Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity.


Training & Qualification

All new hires will complete a structured onboarding program, including:

  • Training sessions and practice exercises
  • Calibration against quality benchmarks
  • Qualification review before moving into production work


Benefits & Employment Structure

This role is hired through an Employer of Record (EOR) partner, ensuring full compliance with local labor laws and payroll requirements.

Employees receive locally compliant benefits, which may include:

  • Statutory benefits (e.g., paid leave, 13th salary where applicable)
  • Social security and healthcare contributions
  • Additional benefits aligned with local market practices


Why Blueprint?

  • Work on cutting-edge AI systems
  • Be part of a global, multilingual team
  • Build highly transferable AI evaluation skills
  • Contribute directly to improving real-world AI experiences


Equal Opportunity Employer

Blueprint Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, or any other protected status.

  • Distributor Development : Identify, evaluate, and onboard distributors that meet company criteria and strategic alignment.
  • Performance Support & Training: Provide motivation, ongoing support, and training to ensure distributors adhere to company standards and deliver expected outcomes.
  • Channel Optimization : Demonstrate strong communication and distributor management skills; conduct regular performance reviews and offer actionable feedback to maintain an effective and healthy distribution network.


Qualifications & Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business Management, Marketing, Trade, Life Sciences, Clinical Sciences or a related field.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in international sales or business development, preferably experience in the laparoscopic industry.
  • Proficiency in English is required
  • Strong sales and negotiation skills. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with experience in cross-cultural communication.

title: Data Annotator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Annotator em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who is Blueprint Technologies?

We are a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with a strong presence across the United States and an expanding footprint across Latin America (LATAM). Our teams are united by a shared passion for solving complex problems.


At Blueprint, we use technology as a bridge between strategy and execution. Our people bring diverse perspectives, deep expertise, and real-world experience across industries to help organizations grow, transform, and innovate.


About the Role

We are seeking detail-oriented Labelers / Annotators to evaluate responses generated by AI systems across multiple languages .


This role focuses on side-by-side (SBS) evaluation of outputs from different AI models across real-world scenarios. You will play a key role in improving how AI systems understand and communicate across languages and cultures.


This is not a translation role . It is an evaluation and analysis role requiring strong judgment and attention to detail.


Language Requirement

Fluency in English + at least one of the following languages:

  • Chinese (Simplified and/or Traditional)
  • Japanese
  • Korean
  • Italian
  • German
  • French


What You’ll Work On

You will evaluate AI responses across scenarios such as:

  • General-purpose Q&A
  • Web search results
  • File-based and image-based responses
  • Image and file generation tasks
  • Single-turn and multi-turn conversations


Responsibilities

  • Perform side-by-side (SBS) comparisons of AI-generated responses
  • Evaluate outputs based on:
  • Accuracy
  • Relevance
  • Clarity
  • Instruction-following
  • Identify nuances in tone, meaning, and cultural context across languages
  • Apply detailed, scenario-specific annotation guidelines
  • Maintain consistency and high-quality evaluations


Required Qualifications

  • Professional fluency in English + at least one target language listed above
  • Prior experience with side-by-side (SBS) labeling or annotation
  • Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail
  • Ability to quickly understand and apply structured evaluation frameworks


Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in linguistics, translation, or localization
  • Experience in:
  • AI evaluation
  • Data annotation
  • Search relevance or content quality analysis


Compensation

We offer competitive compensation aligned with local markets and experience.

Estimated hourly range: R$75 – R$85 BRL

Estimated monthly equivalent (full-time): R$12,000 – R$13,600 BRL

Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity.


Training & Qualification

All new hires will complete a structured onboarding program, including:

  • Training sessions and practice exercises
  • Calibration against quality benchmarks
  • Qualification review before moving into production work


Benefits & Employment Structure

This role is hired through an Employer of Record (EOR) partner, ensuring full compliance with local labor laws and payroll requirements.

Employees receive locally compliant benefits, which may include:

  • Statutory benefits (e.g., paid leave, 13th salary where applicable)
  • Social security and healthcare contributions
  • Additional benefits aligned with local market practices


Why Blueprint?

  • Work on cutting-edge AI systems
  • Be part of a global, multilingual team
  • Build highly transferable AI evaluation skills
  • Contribute directly to improving real-world AI experiences


Equal Opportunity Employer

Blueprint Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, or any other protected status.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisition Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Talent Acquisition Specialist


About Us:

We are a dynamic global specialist in talent research, intelligence, and pipelining. Since its founding in 2011, it’s grown to serve internal talent acquisition teams—including more than 70 Fortune 500 companies —through offices spanning the UK, US, India, Singapore, Dubai, Hong Kong, and beyond. We blend data-driven insight and proactive sourcing to streamline recruitment, delivering seamless access to ready now candidates and curated pipelines for future roles. Its recent acquisition of Armstrong Craven further strengthens our global reach and research capabilities, offering clients unmatched flexibility and depth in talent solutions


The Role:

We have partnered with a global FMCG powerhouse which has a reputation for innovation and development. As part of this contract we are looking for a passionate Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist. If you’re excited by new challenges, solving complex problems, and learning every step of the way, you might be the perfect fit. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to drive impactful projects and collaborate with bright minds.


What You’ll Do:

  • Manage autonomously the different talent acquisition solutions to source, engage, attract, and secure the right talent for the organization within a highly scientific environment
  • Partner with hiring managers to understand hiring needs, execute effective sourcing, engagement, screening, and behavioural-based interviews that deliver a diverse range of candidates and provide an outstanding candidate experience
  • Possess strong ability to screen, assess, interview, and build relationships within different talent communities in a timely and professional manner
  • Build and maintain market intelligence and a network of talent and potential candidates through previous experience, pro-active research, and ongoing relationships; conduct in-depth interviews of potential candidates, demonstrating ability to anticipate manager requirements through high interview-to-offer ratios
  • Display confidence to work with metrics and reporting to establish recruitment updates and insight to ensure hiring is effective and can clearly demonstrate successes versus areas of focus
  • Generate and recommend ideas and strategies related to recruitment that will contribute to the enhancement of hiring processes, implementing changes and new procedures, and fine-tuning standard recruiting processes that fit within the client’s mission
  • Contribute to or lead projects designed to implement change initiatives and enhance delivery
  • Articulate in writing a plan with deliverables, timelines, formal tracking, and reporting results
  • Promote continuous improvement of talent acquisition methods and processes


What we are looking for:

  • Passion for talent acquisition with an extensive track record of recruiting hard to fill roles
  • Expert understanding of talent networks and recruitment landscapes in Brazil and South America
  • Ability to execute sourcing activities, including but not limited to employer brand promotion, talent engagement and attraction, supporting events and meet-ups, and quality candidate pipeline generation with a significant proportion of direct and passive sourcing


Who You Are:

  • Someone who is not satisfied with “just good enough” and is always looking to improve, adapt, and innovate
  • A natural collaborator who loves sharing ideas and learning from others
  • Excellent communicator, both verbally and in writing, able to share complex ideas in a simple, relatable way
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese


Are You Still Curious?

If you’ve read this far, then chances are you’ve got a curious mind—just like us. So, what are you waiting for? Take the leap and apply today. We can’t wait to see where your curiosity leads you—and how it will shape the future of the client.

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

Senior Software Engineer (Backend / Product Engineering)

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join a high-impact team focused on building and scaling systems that power pricing, payments, and merchandising within a luxury resale marketplace. This role sits at the intersection of backend engineering and product development, supporting both customer-facing applications and internal tools used by operators and business teams.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisition Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Talent Acquisition Specialist


About Us:

We are a dynamic global specialist in talent research, intelligence, and pipelining. Since its founding in 2011, it’s grown to serve internal talent acquisition teams—including more than 70 Fortune 500 companies —through offices spanning the UK, US, India, Singapore, Dubai, Hong Kong, and beyond. We blend data-driven insight and proactive sourcing to streamline recruitment, delivering seamless access to ready now candidates and curated pipelines for future roles. Its recent acquisition of Armstrong Craven further strengthens our global reach and research capabilities, offering clients unmatched flexibility and depth in talent solutions


The Role:

We have partnered with a global FMCG powerhouse which has a reputation for innovation and development. As part of this contract we are looking for a passionate Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist. If you’re excited by new challenges, solving complex problems, and learning every step of the way, you might be the perfect fit. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to drive impactful projects and collaborate with bright minds.


What You’ll Do:

  • Manage autonomously the different talent acquisition solutions to source, engage, attract, and secure the right talent for the organization within a highly scientific environment
  • Partner with hiring managers to understand hiring needs, execute effective sourcing, engagement, screening, and behavioural-based interviews that deliver a diverse range of candidates and provide an outstanding candidate experience
  • Possess strong ability to screen, assess, interview, and build relationships within different talent communities in a timely and professional manner
  • Build and maintain market intelligence and a network of talent and potential candidates through previous experience, pro-active research, and ongoing relationships; conduct in-depth interviews of potential candidates, demonstrating ability to anticipate manager requirements through high interview-to-offer ratios
  • Display confidence to work with metrics and reporting to establish recruitment updates and insight to ensure hiring is effective and can clearly demonstrate successes versus areas of focus
  • Generate and recommend ideas and strategies related to recruitment that will contribute to the enhancement of hiring processes, implementing changes and new procedures, and fine-tuning standard recruiting processes that fit within the client’s mission
  • Contribute to or lead projects designed to implement change initiatives and enhance delivery
  • Articulate in writing a plan with deliverables, timelines, formal tracking, and reporting results
  • Promote continuous improvement of talent acquisition methods and processes


What we are looking for:

  • Passion for talent acquisition with an extensive track record of recruiting hard to fill roles
  • Expert understanding of talent networks and recruitment landscapes in Brazil and South America
  • Ability to execute sourcing activities, including but not limited to employer brand promotion, talent engagement and attraction, supporting events and meet-ups, and quality candidate pipeline generation with a significant proportion of direct and passive sourcing


Who You Are:

  • Someone who is not satisfied with “just good enough” and is always looking to improve, adapt, and innovate
  • A natural collaborator who loves sharing ideas and learning from others
  • Excellent communicator, both verbally and in writing, able to share complex ideas in a simple, relatable way
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese


Are You Still Curious?

If you’ve read this far, then chances are you’ve got a curious mind—just like us. So, what are you waiting for? Take the leap and apply today. We can’t wait to see where your curiosity leads you—and how it will shape the future of the client.

title: Data Annotator - Portuguese
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Annotator - Portuguese em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


About the Role


Job Title: Data Annotator

Employment Type: Freelance / Project-Based

Location: Remote (Work From Home)

Work Hours: Flexible; minimum commitment of 4–5 hours per day

Eligibility: Open to candidates with a Bachelor’s degree



We are seeking Data Annotator to support a data annotation and linguistic quality project aimed at training Large Language Models (LLMs) . This is a freelance, remote opportunity that offers flexible working hours.

The role involves understanding cultural and linguistic nuances, reviewing and annotating data, and following detailed project-specific guidelines to enhance AI performance and accuracy.


Key Responsibilities


  • Perform data annotation, and text evaluation in accordance with project-specific guidelines.
  • Ensure high-quality, accurate, and contextually relevant annotations to support Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Review, validate, and refine AI-generated content for grammatical, semantic, and contextual accuracy.
  • Maintain consistency and quality across all deliverables while adhering to established project standards and timelines.
  • Collaborate effectively with the project team to provide feedback and contribute to continuous improvement.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality and comply with all project deadlines and quality assurance protocols.


Required Skills & Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in mandatory.
  • Native proficiency in German language and the English language
  • Prior experience in data annotation , linguistic evaluation , or AI training projects.


What Makes This Role Exciting


  • Fully remote opportunity , allowing you to work comfortably from home.
  • Flexible working hours (4–5 hours per day) to suit your schedule.
  • The chance to contribute to cutting-edge AI and Large Language Model (LLM) training initiatives , shaping the future of language technology.


Note:

For this role, you are required to complete the English assessment within two (2) days from the date it is assigned to you.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de inglês em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


  • O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho
  • Supervisionar o ciclo de entrega dos projetos Nearshore, garantindo padronização, documentação e aderência às práticas de governança da Dexian.
  • Realizar avaliações técnicas dos projetos (arquitetura, qualidade de código, automação, maturidade DevOps) e propor ações de melhoria com base em evidências.
  • Definir e acompanhar KPIs operacionais — velocity, throughput, defect density, taxa de conclusão de sprints, lead time.
  • Participar ativamente de reuniões com clientes US, conduzindo discussões técnicas e de performance com postura executiva.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com os Delivery Managers e o SDM existentes, identificando bloqueios, riscos e oportunidades de melhoria nos times.
  • Monitorar indicadores financeiros dos projetos (GP, utilização, aderência ao SOW) em parceria com Finanças/Ops.
  • Acompanhar satisfação e engajamento dos consultores alocados, identificando sinais de risco de attrition.
  • Apoiar o recrutamento na validação de fit técnico e senioridade de novos recursos.


O que você precisa ter

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas. Mínimo de 7 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento, QA automation ou DevOps, com pelo menos 2 anos em liderança técnica ou de delivery.
  • Profundidade técnica em pelo menos uma área (Cloud/APIs, automação de testes ou DevOps/observabilidade) e capacidade de avaliar criticamente as demais.
  • Experiência com métricas operacionais (KPIs, SLAs, produtividade).
  • Inglês avançado com postura executiva para reuniões com clientes.
  • Experiência com múltiplos projetos simultâneos e metodologias ágeis.


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Vivência e acompanhamento de profissionais alocados


Onde você vai trabalhar?

Celebramos a troca, relações e o poder do contato. Regime remoto.


Regime de Contratação CLT

* Vale Alimentação

title: Senior Frontend Developer (100% Remote Worldwide)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Frontend Developer (100% Remote Worldwide) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.


Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.


Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?


About the job

As a senior Frontend Developer, you will be a part of the team that works on the development and maintenance of the frontend components of multiple applications related to the platform. This includes:

  • New Products and Features - Tether continuously strives to create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional experience for customers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies, to ensure the user experience remains the best in the industry.
  • Performance - all ui components that power Tether platform must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth.
  • Security - Tether makes Security its most important feature. The Frontend Development team is responsible for building all the interactions with API services with the highest security principles and standard, in order to protect the safety of the entire user base.


Responsibilities

Collaborate with the team to work on the development of the Bitfinex KYC webapps. Including:

  • New Features: Create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional KYC experience for customers and compliance officers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies.
  • Scalability: The web application must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth.
  • Design: Build beautiful reactive applications and trading tools.
  • Domain knowledge: willing to learn the domain-related logic and condition-based logic, including the one based on difference between multiple users scenarios and combinations of factors
  • Debugging: Being able to debug hidden/hard to find issues when needed, advanced usage of browser debugging tools, including network, source, stop points etc.


Requirements

  • With 5+ years of proven experience in software development, with a strong focus on Frontend.
  • Knowledgeable and experienced with micro-service architecture.
  • Comfortable with high-availability concepts.
  • Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+.
  • Thoroughly experienced with React, SASS, Redux, build tools and the core principles surrounding these.
  • Some backend experience to be able to run the app locally via NodeJS, with MongoDB, configuring ports and local environment
  • Familiar with modern front-end pipelines and tools.
  • Experienced with RESTful and RPC-based APIs.
  • Interest in bringing diverse, innovative applications to life.
  • Interest in modernising and optimising different web applications.


Important information for candidates

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:
  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?


About the job

As a senior Frontend Developer, you will be a part of the team that works on the development and maintenance of the frontend components of multiple applications related to the platform. This includes:

  • New Products and Features - Tether continuously strives to create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional experience for customers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies, to ensure the user experience remains the best in the industry.
  • Performance - all ui components that power Tether platform must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth.
  • Security - Tether makes Security its most important feature. The Frontend Development team is responsible for building all the interactions with API services with the highest security principles and standard, in order to protect the safety of the entire user base.


Responsibilities

Collaborate with the team to work on the development of the Bitfinex KYC webapps. Including:

  • New Features: Create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional KYC experience for customers and compliance officers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies.
  • Scalability: The web application must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth.
  • Design: Build beautiful reactive applications and trading tools.
  • Domain knowledge: willing to learn the domain-related logic and condition-based logic, including the one based on difference between multiple users scenarios and combinations of factors
  • Debugging: Being able to debug hidden/hard to find issues when needed, advanced usage of browser debugging tools, including network, source, stop points etc.


Requirements

  • With 5+ years of proven experience in software development, with a strong focus on Frontend.
  • Knowledgeable and experienced with micro-service architecture.
  • Comfortable with high-availability concepts.
  • Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+.
  • Thoroughly experienced with React, SASS, Redux, build tools and the core principles surrounding these.
  • Some backend experience to be able to run the app locally via NodeJS, with MongoDB, configuring ports and local environment
  • Familiar with modern front-end pipelines and tools.
  • Experienced with RESTful and RPC-based APIs.
  • Interest in bringing diverse, innovative applications to life.
  • Interest in modernising and optimising different web applications.


Important information for candidates

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:
  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

title: Senior Backend Developer KYC (100% remote Worldwide)
description:

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. But that’s just the beginning:

Are you ready to be part of the future?


About the job

As a senior Backend Developer, you will be a part of the team that works on the development and maintenance of the backend components of multiple services related to the platform. This includes:

  • New Products and Features - Tether continuously strives to create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional experience for customers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies, to ensure the user experience remains the best in the industry.
  • Scalability - all backend services that power Tether platform must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth.
  • Security - Tether makes Security its most important feature. The Backend Development team is responsible for building all the API services and backend processes with the highest security principles and standard, in order to protect the safety of the entire user base.


Responsibilities

  • Work closely with developers, product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to translate requirements into clear, practical architectures.
  • Improve existing core backend services written in NodeJS
  • Implement new solutions that interact with different core services through RPC calls
  • Write complex database queries for compliance and financial purposes


Requirements

  • At least 5 years of experience working with Javascript/Nodejs.
  • Familiar with microservices architecture
  • Have actively participated in the development of a complex platform
  • Good experience in interacting with databases (MySQL, MongoDB)
  • Ability to quickly learn new technologies
  • Good understanding of security practices


Preferred skills

  • Experience with blockchain integration
  • Comfortable with high-availability concepts
  • Ruby and Rails experience
  • Other technologies of interest: Message queues (Redis), Caches and Job Queues


Important information for candidates

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:
  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de Dados Sênior em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a Volpi

Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando a evolução do financiamento imobiliário . Transformamos processos tradicionalmente burocráticos, caros e ineficientes em experiências inteligentes, simples e digitais . Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas - e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática - vem com a gente!


O desafio

Buscamos um Senior Data Engineer para liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.

Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.

Aqui, você terá alto nível de autonomia e ownership , tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da Volpi , com foco em um modelo de lakehouse na AWS;
  • Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);
  • Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de segurança, governança e compliance ;
  • Lidar com dados distribuídos em múltiplos silos , conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio;
  • Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
  • Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
  • Criar a base para produtos de dados futuros , incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados;
  • Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência sólida como Data Engineer , com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev);
  • Domínio de Python e SQL para construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção;
  • Experiência prática com AWS , especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM;
  • Conhecimento e uso de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) ;
  • Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
  • Forte preocupação com segurança da informação , padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Experiência em ambientes de startup , lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero;
  • Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;
  • Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos.


Será considerado um diferencial:

  • Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse;
  • Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares);
  • Atuação em domínios complexos e regulados, como financeiro, crédito ou seguros;
  • Vivência na construção e estruturação de plataformas ou áreas de dados desde o início.



Benefícios que oferecemos:

  • Modelo remoto prioritário
  • Plano de saúde Alice (100% pago para titular e dependentes)
  • R$600/ano para infraestrutura de home office
  • R$1.000/ano de auxílio educação

  • Day off no aniversário
  • TotalPass (incluindo TotalMind)
  • Acesso ao Wework
  • Encontros presenciais para troca e conexão com a nossa Tribo

Parte da dentsu, dentsu internacional com sede em Londres, opera em mais de 145 mercados no mundo inteiro com mais de 48.000 colaboradores. Portanto, quer você se junte a nós, quer procure mudar para uma parte diferente do negócio, nós trabalhamos duro para garantir a criação de oportunidades iguais para todos.

Com mais de 48.000 especialistas dedicados em 145 mercados, nossas '8 maneiras' formam e guiam a maneira como fazemos as coisas aqui, de modo que, juntos, podemos alcançar o 'nunca antes' para nossos clientes, para a sociedade e uns para os outros.
